business_problem: Toolstation, one of Britain's fastest-growing tool suppliers, needed customers to be able to find products easily on its site. Migrating its search experience to AI Commerce Search on Gemini for customer experience, Toolstation gave customers highly accurate search results, driving significant increases in click-through rate and search-based revenue.
solution_summary: Toolstation, one of Britain's fastest-growing tool suppliers, needed customers to be able to find products easily on its site. Migrating its search experience to AI Commerce Search on Gemini for customer experience, Toolstation gave customers highly accurate search results, driving significant increases in click-through rate and search-based revenue. Having maintained a strong relationship with the Google Cloud team since migrating to the platform in 2020, Toolstation requested a demonstration and was impressed with the ability of AI Commerce Search to return accurate results for terms that its third-party tool struggled with. With a culture of experimentation at the company, Toolstation was keen to move fast, and decided to put the technology to the test. The retailer uploaded its entire product catalog in one night and set about testing Agent Search on Gemini platform on live traffic on the website the very next day.

business_outcome: Following its success with Agent Search, Toolstation has decided to migrate all its discovery tools, including browse, recommendations and personalization features, to AI Commerce Search. Bringing all its search and discovery tools to Google Cloud will not only help to simplify its tech stack and deliver a better customer experience, it will also increase efficiency at Toolstation.
